title: Update Ludo, Chess, and Carrom icons to realistic images without changing asset paths

requirements.summary: Replace Ludo/Chess/Carrom icon assets with more realistic visuals while keeping the same filenames/paths so the existing HomeScreen game cards update automatically and navigation/gameplay remain unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: The images at /assets/generated/ludo-icon.dim_512x512.png, /assets/generated/chess-icon.dim_512x512.png, and /assets/generated/carrom-icon.dim_512x512.png are updated to look more realistic (photorealistic or realistic 3D render style).
HomeScreen game cards render the updated images (no broken links; images remain 512x512 and look crisp when shown in the square thumbnail).
No changes to game rules, game logic, or navigation flow (onSelectGame continues to work as-is).

file_operations.description: Replace the existing Ludo icon with a more realistic (photorealistic or realistic 3D render) 512x512 image, keeping the exact same filename/path so existing UI references continue to work.
Replace the existing Chess icon with a more realistic (photorealistic or realistic 3D render) 512x512 image, keeping the exact same filename/path so existing UI references continue to work.
Replace the existing Carrom icon with a more realistic (photorealistic or realistic 3D render) 512x512 image, keeping the exact same filename/path so existing UI references continue to work.
